items.title: George Justin Interview, 1958-06-01
items.q: I worked with Kid Renee for a while when they first opened up the New Gypsy Tea Room in 1932.

ctx.x: But of course I would consider myself at that time not too much of a good judge of music or talent because I didn't know too much about it. But I could remember fellas like Buddy Petit and Sam Organ, old Sam Organ, and Chris Kelly, Kid Renee, and matter of fact I worked with Kid Renee for a while when they first opened up the New Gypsy Tea Room in 1932. Oh yeah, there on St. Philip and St. Philip.
In 1932. When they first opened up there I worked with him.

items.title: George Justin Interview, 1958-06-01
items.q: I remember it so much because at the time I was working with Rene, he used to do it just about once a night.

ctx.x: Did they learn the regular French too?

Yes, they learned French, I guess it was handed down to them from their mothers and fathers. But I guess maybe one of the reasons why I didn't learn too much about it, because I was probably out in the streets someplace trying to see what's going on. And the only thing about it, I noticed when they used to have company and they were talking about something that they didn't want kids to know anything about, so they immediately went into Creole. So we were completely lost and we'd have to leave. So we were getting…
Do you remember what it was?
